final: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT event_status, AVG(amount - spent) AS average_difference FROM budget GROUP BY event_status), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_difference) AS overall_average FROM status_averages) SELECT s.event_status, s.average_difference, s.average_difference - o.overall_average FROM status_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_average IS NOT NULL
